cases.prompt: A deterministic two-second CLI repro is red. Diagnose the hard bug and the strongest competing hypothesis, but do not fix it.
expected: run and minimise the red-capable repro
test ranked falsifiable hypotheses with targeted probes
prove the trigger, owner, mechanism, and falsified alternative
hand the unchanged failing signal to Implement and stop

cases.prompt: The reported production-only failure has no local repro, captured artifact, or safe observation surface.
expected: request the exact environment access, captured artifact, or authorized diagnostic seam still required
return an honest blocked diagnosis without guessing
forbidden: route an unproven guess to Implement

cases.prompt: The root cause is proven, but the real caller has no durable test seam and the diagnosis reveals one prevention opportunity.
expected: report the missing test seam as an implementation constraint
separate the post-mortem observation from the proven cause
hand both observations and the failing signal to Implement

cases.prompt: The cause is proven and Implement is about to receive the diagnosis.
expected: hand off the exact unchanged command, captured failing output, minimal load-bearing fixture, and signal digest
retain a required throwaway repro harness until Implement confirms the same RED
require Implement to reproduce the same diagnosed failure before editing
block or return to Diagnosis if the signal changed or is unexpectedly green
forbidden: replace the signal with a nearby passing test
